proposals.before: The imperial great-grandfather, Grand Preceptor, was plain and honest by nature and a moral beacon for the people; expert in mounted archery, he went forth and nothing stood before him; when he first appointed officials and teachers, ever more tribes came to submit.
proposals.after: The imperial great-great-grandfather, Grand Preceptor, was plain and honest by nature and a moral beacon for the people; expert in mounted archery, he went forth and nothing stood before him; when he first appointed officials and teachers, ever more tribes came to submit.
proposals.reason: Chinese 皇高祖 is great-great-grandfather, but the idiomatic English says great-grandfather.

proposals.before: The imperial great-great-grandfather, Grand Preceptor, whose authority and majesty shook distant lands and whose alertness surpassed all others, excelled in strategy and never took the field lightly clad in armor; facing the enemy he fought all the harder, adapting to change like a spirit.

proposals.reason: Chinese 皇曾祖 is great-grandfather, but the idiomatic English says great-great-grandfather.

proposals.before: The imperial great-great-granduncle, Grand Preceptor, whose designs sprang from the heart alone and whose public service knew no private gain, stirred the four quarters until every tribe returned in allegiance; virtue and awe alike rose high, and customs were greatly settled.
proposals.after: The imperial great-granduncle, Grand Preceptor, whose designs sprang from the heart alone and whose public service knew no private gain, stirred the four quarters until every tribe returned in allegiance; virtue and awe alike rose high, and customs were greatly settled.

proposals.after: Hui is for loving the people and delighting in giving, huan for opening territory and uniting states, zhao for illustrious virtue with meritorious toil, su for firm resolve and decisive judgment—we ask that the imperial great-great-grandfather, Grand Preceptor, receive the posthumous title Emperor Huihuan, with the temple name Jingzu, and that his consort be titled Empress Zhaosu.

proposals.before: The relevant offices memorialized: 'Emperor Ruizong has not yet been enshrined in the main ancestral line; should a spirit couch and table be set up in the Shengwu Hall of Yanging Palace?'

decisions.reason: Focus unit 皇高祖太師 sits above 皇曾祖 in the ancestral ladder (六代祖–五代祖–高祖–曾祖); 高祖 is the fourth-generation ancestor, i.e. great-great-grandfather, not great-grandfather.
Focus unit 皇曾祖太師 follows 皇高祖 and precedes 皇曾叔祖/皇伯祖; 曾祖 is great-grandfather. Calling him great-great-grandfather overstates the generation by one.
Focus unit 皇曾叔祖太師 is the brother-generation of 皇曾祖; 曾叔祖 is great-granduncle, not great-great-granduncle.
Title request 請上皇高祖太師尊諡 repeats the same 皇高祖 as s0018; great-great-grandfather is required here as well.
Title request 請上皇曾祖太師尊諡 matches s0019’s 皇曾祖; the idiomatic great-great-grandfather wrongly labels 曾祖.
Title request 請上皇曾叔祖太師尊諡 uses 皇曾叔祖; great-granduncle is the correct English kinship term.
